search_scope: official publisher and DOI landing pages
public GitHub repositories with hydrogen pressure-flow traces

required: vehicle or receiving-vessel pressure and temperature
initial conditions, units and reuse terms
excluded_substitutes: aggregate operating KPIs without synchronized rows
sampling-system traces without a vehicle or receiving-tank mapping

candidates.reason: Temperature/pressure files describe a sampling system; no vehicle receiving-tank and station-controller channel contract was supplied.
Public sampling-system measurements improve component diagnostics but do not provide a synchronized station-to-vehicle holdout.
The repository describes a metal-hydride storage-reaction rig rather than a hydrogen refueling station or vehicle fill.
The publication reports multi-year real-station operation and aggregate fueling information, but no downloadable synchronized raw logger archive was located.

next_action: Request a de-identified, rights-cleared, pre-freeze station-to-vehicle logger cohort from an identified custodian; retain this search result as a negative public-access decision.
claim_boundary: This artifact documents a current public search and exclusion decision. It adds no numerical validation, does not alter any frozen holdout, and does not support a safety or IJHE full-loop claim.
